# odinex_rdns (Resource)

Manages the reverse DNS (PTR) entry of a server's public IP, a primary IP or a floating IP. Exactly one of `server_id`, `primary_ip_id` and `floating_ip_id` must be set. The import ID is `s-<server_id>-<ip>`, `p-<primary_ip_id>-<ip>` or `f-<floating_ip_id>-<ip>`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "odinex_rdns" "web" {
  server_id  = odinex_server.web.id
  ip_address = odinex_server.web.ipv4_address
  dns_ptr    = "web-1.example.com"
}

resource "odinex_rdns" "floating" {
  floating_ip_id = odinex_floating_ip.web.id
  ip_address     = odinex_floating_ip.web.ip_address
  dns_ptr        = "www.example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `dns_ptr` (String) Hostname the IP resolves to. It must already resolve to the IP (forward-confirmed reverse DNS).
- `ip_address` (String) The IP address the entry is for.

### Optional

- `floating_ip_id` (Number) ID of the floating IP.
- `primary_ip_id` (Number) ID of the primary IP.
- `server_id` (Number) ID of the server whose public IP gets the entry.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Unique ID of the resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# s-<server_id>-<ip>, p-<primary_ip_id>-<ip> or f-<floating_ip_id>-<ip>
terraform import odinex_rdns.web s-42-198.51.100.7
terraform import odinex_rdns.floating f-8-203.0.113.9
```
